rule: Gov EndBlocker processes active proposals whose voting period has ended at the current block time.
A successful passed proposal handler mutates state and writes the cache in EndBlock(H).
Gov emits active_proposal with proposal_id and proposal_result=proposal_passed.
Mint runs in BeginBlock; BeginBlock(H) precedes Gov EndBlock(H).
Therefore, once exact execution block H is proven, first mint able to use the changed parameters is H+1.
